11.t: Working with data: diffusion and temperature
q: How long did the colour take to spread at 20 degrees C?
How many times faster did it spread at 80 degrees C than at 20 degrees C?
Describe the relationship between temperature and time.
As temperature increases, the time decreases: quickly at first, then more slowly (a curve).
Explain the pattern with particles, and suggest one variable that must be controlled.
Hotter water particles move faster and the dye particles too, so they spread out more quickly. Control: volume of water, size of drop, no stirring or knocking the bench, same beaker.
